items.title: BlackRock Launches Tokenized Money Market Funds on Solana, Ethereum
items.whyYouShouldCare: BlackRock's entry into tokenized money market funds on Solana and Ethereum enhances institutional credibility and could increase liquidity and usage within the Solana ecosystem.

items.title: Solana boosted block capacity 66%, but traders still hit the same wall
items.whyYouShouldCare: Despite a 66% increase in block capacity, traders continue to face congestion issues, indicating a need for further improvements in Solana's scalability.

items.title: Solana’s price shows strength at $70, but whale exit sparks bigger fears
items.whyYouShouldCare: Solana's price stability at $70 is overshadowed by whale activity, raising concerns about potential market volatility and its impact on investor confidence.
